civilopediaText.text: The mystical energy that fuels all magic. Accumulate Soul Power to amplify your armies and fortify your cities.
Crystallized magical energy found deep within the earth. Essential for arcane construction.
A legendary metal lighter than steel but stronger than iron. Favored by dwarven smiths and elven artisans.
The hardest substance known to exist. Weapons forged from adamantine can pierce any defense.
The remains of ancient dragons, pulsing with residual magical power. Highly prized by necromancers and artificers.
The distilled essence of living beings. Dark and potent, it is the fuel of the most forbidden magics.
Metal fallen from the stars. It hums with cosmic energy and is said to be forged by the gods themselves.
A feather from the mythical phoenix. It radiates warmth and is said to grant immortality to those who possess it.
The spiral horn of a unicorn. It purifies water and heals any wound.
A flower that only blooms under the light of a full moon. Its fragrance induces prophetic visions.
A rare substance produced by leviathans of the deep. Used in the finest perfumes and potent elixirs.
Silk spun by spiders that dwell in the darkest caves. It is nearly invisible in dim light.
A gemstone that burns with an inner flame. It never cools and provides warmth even in the coldest winters.
A lotus that grows only on frozen lakes. Its petals are colder than ice and never melt.
Wood from trees that can speak. It resonates with magical energy and is perfect for crafting staves.
Bioluminescent fungi that light up the darkest caverns. Used in potions and as a natural light source.
A tuber with skin as hard as iron. It is nutritious and can be refined into a crude metal substitute.
